# Helvety Store

> Catalog pages with product specs, Store-hosted downloads (for example SPFx packages), and install links (for example the Chrome Web Store). Product prose is aligned with each app’s documentation. Hosted from Switzerland.

## Canonical URLs
- [Store Home](https://helvety.com/store): Main store entry
- [Products](https://helvety.com/store/products): Product listing

## Product pages
The authoritative catalog is [Products](https://helvety.com/store/products); individual pages include:
- [Helvety SPO Explorer](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-spo-explorer)
- [Helvety PDF](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-pdf)
- [Helvety Image Upscaler](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-image-upscaler)
- [Helvety Image Editor](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-image-editor)
- [Helvety Screen Tools](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-screen-tools)
- [Helvety Tasks](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-tasks)
- [Helvety Contacts](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-contacts)
- [Helvety Notes](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-notes)
- [Helvety Links](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-links)
- [Helvety Browser Extension](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-browser-extension): Open beta Chromium side panel for your encrypted Helvety tasks, notes, contacts, and links. Sign in, unlock with a passkey, then create and edit in the panel. Manual install from GitHub releases while it is not yet in the Chrome Web Store: https://github.com/CasparRubin/helvety-browser-extension-chromium/releases
- [Power Platform Configurator](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-power-platform-configurator): Configure Power Automate cloud flows: Classic or New Designer. Hide the survey prompt by default. Pause anytime. Survey tab: optional v3survey control. Hide (default) sets false on rewrites; Show only normalizes when already present. Paused: no URL rewrites while the extension stays installed. Install from the Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/power-platform-configurat/mdneakhceachnimmejciaehnfjfabang

## Crawling And Indexing
- Public catalog and product pages are intended to be crawlable and indexable.
- Account routes are intended not to be indexed and are protected by authentication and noindex metadata.

## Licensing
All Helvety products with published source are released under AGPL-3.0 or later (including browser extensions, SharePoint solutions, and desktop tools distributed outside this repository).

## Source
- [GitHub - helvety.com monorepo](https://github.com/CasparRubin/helvety): Web applications and shared packages (AGPL-3.0)
